scope: The eight actual associated constants and eleven public conversions with exact integer values and exact Overflow partitions, without public input preconditions. The actual negative_bits and U256::checked_sub dependencies and two-limb carry/borrow helper instantiations are refined. Other helper widths, other arithmetic and compiler/ghost-erasure correspondence are not proved.
assumptions: Soundness of the pinned Verus frontend, vstd specifications and SMT solver.
Correspondence between Rust compilation and the proof frontend, including ghost erasure and the reviewed constant annotations.
Standard Rust fixed-width integer and array semantics as specified by the pinned verifier; native execution is separately tested.
